FAB.Title: Frontier Atlas Bridge
FAB.Status.unbound: scene is not linked to the hub
FAB.Auto.label: Auto-send scouting (no preview)
FAB.Auto.hint: When the hexcrawl records an arrival, newly discovered hexes are sent to the hub and the background is redrawn. Only opens hexes. Applies to this browser.
FAB.Auto.sent: Frontier Atlas: sent {n} hexes to the hub.
FAB.TokenHint: The token gives access to every secret of the campaign. It is stored only in this browser, separately for each world.
FAB.Scene.new: A new scene will be created: {w}x{h}px, background = the players' map.
FAB.Scene.recreate: The map size changed: a new scene will be created. The old scene stays as it is (tokens, walls, hexcrawl) and is no longer updated by the bridge.
FAB.Scene.bg: The background will be redrawn (the players' map changed).
FAB.Scene.noBg: The background is up to date.
FAB.Scene.safe: Tokens, walls, drawings and hexcrawl state are not touched.
FAB.Zones.noModule: great-route-hex-crawl is not installed or not active.
FAB.Zones.old: Update great-route-hex-crawl to 0.3.0: this version has no API for the bridge. Zones are skipped.
FAB.Zones.tooBig: The hexcrawl config would reach {mb} MB and exceed its 2 MB limit.
FAB.Zones.newStorage: The scene has no hexcrawl storage: it will be created (ticking this box confirms it).
FAB.Zones.line: Zones: create {c}, update cells {u}, emptied {e}; journal links: set {l}, cleared {x}.
FAB.Zones.dropped: Deleted roll tables are removed from {n} zone bindings.
FAB.Zones.foreign: Hexes with your own journal link stay as they are: {list}
FAB.Zones.warn: The zones fa-terrain-* are repainted by the hub terrain. Bindings, label and priority you configured stay untouched.
FAB.Conflicts.title: Changed in Foundry
FAB.Conflicts.hint: These journal entries were edited in Foundry and the hub changed them too. By default they are not touched; tick to replace them with the hub version.
FAB.DonePartial: Applied in part: something was skipped, the hub still shows an update.
FAB.Scout.none: No new hexes to open: the hub already knows everything the hexcrawl has discovered.
FAB.Scout.will: {n} hexes will be opened in the hub: {list}
FAB.Scout.sent: Opened {n} hexes in the hub; the background was redrawn.
FAB.Update.title: The hub has an update (rev {from} to {to})
FAB.Update.ask: The hub has an update for this map (rev {from} to {to}). Open the preview?
FAB.Log.journal: Journal: created {c}, updated {u}, deleted {d}, left unchanged as edited in Foundry {k}.
FAB.Log.zones: Hexcrawl: zones created {c}, changed {u}; journal links set {l}, cleared {x}.
FAB.Err.badUrl: The hub URL is not valid (expected http:// or https://).
FAB.Err.noToken: No token. Create one in the hub: campaign page, Foundry panel.
FAB.Err.timeout: The hub did not answer in time.
FAB.Err.mixed: The hub is unreachable. Foundry is open over https, so a browser blocks an http hub ({detail}); use an https address.
FAB.Err.auth: The token is wrong or revoked (its creator may no longer be a GM). Create a new one in the hub.
FAB.Err.version: The hub map has an unknown format version ({detail}). Update the bridge module.
FAB.Err.upload: Could not upload the background image to the world folder.
FAB.Err.pngSize: The rendered background is {w}x{h} but {ew}x{eh} was expected.
FAB.Err.notBound: This scene was not created by the bridge. Get the map from the hub first.
FAB.Err.geometry: The scene grid differs from the hub map. Get the update first.
